notes.title: Patch notes 0.8.02
notes.content:
Patch notes  0.8.02 - Medieval Darkness DEMO

9-18-25

Welcome back for another update Strange ones!

Let's see what the creator has is store for you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307992/70b516632c34d24c83d7ffbdb3e74bc3517c29aa.png"]


Items:

-Gems for socketed items are now on boss drop tables. Go get em tiger!

-The lizardman underground has better loot now!

Quest:

-Removed one of the campfire building options to make Thora’s fire quest less confusing.

-Carter Carter will now give a quest to sit at the table next to her… and there is now an icon showing where the table is.  

Skills/Spells:

The mage Teleport spells now have a working UI!

UI:

-Moved Steam password prompts.

-Lock icon on server browsers now showing correctly.




-Mech Monkey Studios Devs

notes.title: Upcoming Playtest
notes.content:
Hello Chosen ones!

The time for our first ever playtest is quickly approaching. It has a been a long road for our two man dev team. But we are almost ready to have a limited number of outside alpha tester to check out our game. We hope to have a weekend playtest very soon!

If you have already clicked the request access button on our store page and received an email saying it you can install the playtest please disregard. The playtest isn't available yet. We will make an announcement here before the playtest, but please join our discord for the latest info.
